tools.name: sebbi_overview
tools.description: What sebbi.pro offers: every product, what it does, its page, and the price. Start here.

tools.name: sebbi_terms
tools.description: The service terms and their version. Show these to the customer in full and get a clear yes before calling sebbi_create_account.

tools.name: sebbi_create_account
tools.description: Open a sebbi.pro account for the customer and return their API key. Only call after showing sebbi_terms and the customer saying yes. Seals the agreement into the chain.

tools.name: sebbi_setup_advice
tools.description: Recommend the right sebbi.pro products and give step-by-step setup with working code or a ready prompt, for how the customer builds (Python, Node, Lovable, Zapier, a website, etc.)

tools.name: sebbi_test_decision
tools.description: Send one real decision through the live engine with the customer's key and show the verdict and the sealed block.

tools.name: sebbi_pack_reference
tools.description: How Signal Packs are written: the signals, measurements, flags, operators and verdicts. Read before writing a pack.

tools.name: sebbi_check_pack
tools.description: Check a Signal Pack with the engine's own validator without publishing it.

tools.name: sebbi_publish_pack
tools.description: Publish a Signal Pack to the open library. It is sealed into the chain, dated and credited to its author. Free.

tools.name: sebbi_list_packs
tools.description: Browse the published Signal Pack library.

tools.name: sebbi_decision_report
tools.description: The machine-proof report for one decision the customer's key sealed: the decision, who sent it, where it came from, and proof it has not changed.

tools.name: sebbi_check_human_proof
tools.description: Look up a Human Keys code (HK-XXXX-XXXX): whether a human typed the text, live, and when.

tools.name: sebbi_billing_link
tools.description: A secure Stripe link for the customer to add their card and set up the 50p per device subscription.

tools.name: sebbi_verify_chain
tools.description: Re-verify sebbi.pro's whole chain and return its height and tip. Anyone can run this.

tools.name: sebbi_check_source
tools.description: Garbage-in guard. Check whether a piece of data is genuinely vouched for by its claimed source domain (a sebbi Verified Source that hosts /.well-known/sebbi-source.json). Returns GENUINE, UNVERIFIED or UNKNOWN, sealed into Bitcoin. Call this before trusting an input.

tools.name: sebbi_insurability
tools.description: Rate an AI deployment against The Insurable AI Standard and seal an Insurability Certificate into Bitcoin. Composes an Insurability Level (I-0 UNRATED to I-4 PRE-CLEARED) from PROVABLE controls: its Verified-Source domain and its MCP-Shield code are checked live against sealed proofs (VERIFIED); log

tools.name: sebbi_verify_insurability
tools.description: For insurers and auditors. Verify an Insurability Certificate (IC-XXXX-XXXX) against the sebbi chain: returns the Insurability Level, which pillars are VERIFIED vs ATTESTED, whether it is still the current certificate for its domain, and the Bitcoin seal. Read-only, no account needed.
